\section{Conclusion}\label{sec:conclusion}

We present the first systematic comparison of hidden-state and text-based probes for safety commitment detection in reasoning models. Layer selection is a critical researcher degree of freedom: a biased composite metric reverses the HS advantage at 32B scale, while principled selection recovers significance on all four models (precision +15.4 to +32.5pp over 384d text, Holm-Bonferroni corrected; 1/4 against 1024d). Future work should close the oracle gap through causal interventions~\citep{meng2022rome} and test whether LLM-based text encoders close the remaining modality gap.
